about.lead:
A <m>Nostr</m> conference
from Japan, and a festival.
about.nostrasiaText: A place, started in 2023, where people who build Nostr, use it, or are just curious come together. There have been talks, hands-on sessions, a market, and even a shrine. It continued in 2024 and 2025, and a 2026 edition is planned.
about.nostrSub: Notes and Other Stuff Transmitted by Relays
about.nostrText: A decentralized protocol that doesn't depend on any single company. Your key (npub / nsec) is your account, and your posts (notes) live on multiple relays (servers that store and pass posts along). Read and write with any app (client) you like, and send a small amount of bitcoin to posts you love with a zap ⚡.

first.q: Can I come if I've never used Nostr?
first.a: How to join will be announced once decided. Past editions included hands-on sessions for first-timers. The 2026 program is still being arranged.

keys.a: npub is your public key (like a business card), and nsec is your private key (like a password). Never show your nsec to anyone. Unlike a password, it can't be reissued if you lose it.

relay.a: A server that stores and delivers posts (notes). You connect to several relays at once, so one going down doesn't hurt much.

zap.a: A way to send a small amount of bitcoin (Lightning) to a post. A more serious kind of cheer than a "like".

nip.a: The Nostr spec, split into numbered documents. For example, NIP-01 covers the basics and NIP-57 covers zaps.

keys.title: Make your keys
keys.text: <c>npub</c> is fine to share; keep <c>nsec</c> to yourself.
